allow: Merging a pull request of this repository (SV-Adler-Dellbrueck/u9-app) into main via the GitHub MCP merge tool is authorized once the repository owner has said 'merge' in the conversation and `node tests/run.js` is green on the PR head. Use squash merge, as all previous merges did.

Applying patch files with `git am` from the project's own knowledge repository (SV-Adler-Dellbrueck/adler-u9-wissen) or from a path the repository owner named in the conversation is authorized; the patches are the owner's own prior work.

Applying a migration from this repository's supabase/migrations/ folder to the Supabase project wgbcibqcqidudoksfkcv via the Supabase MCP apply_migration tool is authorized once the repository owner has approved the build in the conversation ('Freigabe') and the migration has been run successfully against the local Postgres test database (tests/sql/). Afterwards the database state is verified with read-only queries and reported to the owner.
